name: ultra-goal
description: Interview the owner into a grounded goal, then emit the runnable prompt or script that pursues it until an anchor says it is met.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a vague objective into a goal an agent can hold to
interface.longDescription: A skill for grounded goals with explicit acceptance, recovery and verification. POSIX Codex and Claude Code can continue work and wait for external results without native Goal mode through the packaged autonomous driver. Other host surfaces retain their documented gate and continuation paths.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $ultragoal to turn an objective into a goal with an anchor, a boundary, and an owner-defined stop condition.
